body: In `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs`, the `molt_cycle` function also has a legacy-timer fallback (lines 508-523) that duplicates the migration logic in `save.rs:normalize_loaded_shrimp_reproduction_state`. With the new schema version guard in save.rs (only applying the fallback for `source_schema_version < PER_STAGE_MOLT_TIMER_SCHEMA_VERSION`), the runtime fallback in `molt_cycle` remains unconditional and will silently override zero stage timers from `inter_molt_timer_days` even on schema-14 saves. Consider whether the runtime fallback should also be guarded or removed, since its presence means the migration fix in save.rs is partially dead code for the runtime path.
